# Community Course "Household Budgeting Basics": Application Guide

Minato City Board of Education

## 1 Overview

Applications: Monday, October 5, 2026 to Wednesday, September 30, 2026

Course dates: Friday, November 13, 2026 to Friday, December 11, 2026 (every Friday, five sessions)

Places: 30 (if more people apply, a draw decides)

## 2 Who can apply

You can apply if all of (1) to (3) apply to you.

(1) You live in the city.
(2) You are 18 or older.
(4) You can attend all five sessions.

## 3 Fees

The fees are as follows.

| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Course fee | $20 |
| Materials | $15 |
| Total | $38 |

## 4 How to apply

Send the application form (Annex 1) to the Lifelong Learning Section with the following four documents:

- a copy of a document showing your address
- the receipt for the course fee
- a return envelope

A filled-in example of the form is in Annex 2.

We accept only a driving licence, a health insurance card, etc. as proof of identity.

## 5 Contact

Lifelong Learning Section, Minato City Board of Education. Phone: 045-123-4567

Hours: weekdays, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. On the closing day, Thursday, October 30, 2026, we take applications until 5 p.m.

For questions by phone, call 045-123-4576.

## Annex 1 Application form

Write your name, address, phone number and date of birth.
